1.0.0.en: Initial release — control your SofaBaton X2 devices from Homey over MQTT, and trigger Homey Flows from the remote's MQTT buttons.
1.0.0.da: Første udgave — styr dine SofaBaton X2-apparater fra Homey via MQTT, og udløs Homey-Flows fra fjernbetjeningens MQTT-knapper.

1.0.1.en: Initial release — control your SofaBaton devices from Homey over MQTT and trigger Homey Flows from the remote's MQTT buttons. Includes automatic hub discovery (mDNS) and Homey-IP broker defaults for easy setup.

1.0.3.en: New: a "Pause connection" switch right on the device — release the hub for the SofaBaton app with one tap, no need to dig into settings. Thanks to Ib Thomsen for the suggestion!
1.0.3.da: Nyt: en "Pause forbindelse"-kontakt direkte på enheden — slip hub'en til SofaBaton-appen med ét tryk, uden at gå ind i indstillinger. Tak til Ib Thomsen for forslaget!

1.0.4.en: added pause button next to refresh on device card

1.0.6.en: Pause switch now has a clear label on the device card

1.0.8.en: English pause label, hub reboot tip, and a setup-guide link on the app page

1.0.10.en: A clearer app page, a link to the illustrated setup guide, and new app and device images.
1.0.10.da: Klarere app-side, link til den illustrerede opsætningsguide og nye app- og enhedsbilleder.

1.0.11.en: New “And” cards for Flows: check whether the hub connection is paused, and whether the last pressed button was a specific one. Device and key dropdowns now also work while the connection is paused. Thanks to Aaron Powell for asking!
1.0.11.da: Nye “Og”-kort til Flows: tjek om hub-forbindelsen er på pause, og om det sidste knaptryk var en bestemt tast. Enheds- og tastelisterne virker nu også, mens forbindelsen er på pause. Tak til Aaron Powell for spørgsmålet!
